title: Req: Track Hardware ID/Advertiser ID
body:
A simple request that you track the Hardware/Advertiser ID in future for users, allowing us to do more with their data at a later date.

Thanks.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: I don't think this can be implemented and safely comply with GDPR and Privacy Shield requirements anymore. It should be handled by game teams within their own client and/or server custom code.

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
